basic_details.short_information: Mizoram University (MZU) wants a Director for the DRDO - Industry Academia Centre of Excellence, Mizoram University (DIA-CoE, MZU). This is a full-time contract post, starting with a 3-year appointment. For non-government candidates the pay is Rs. 1,72,200 – 1,99,600/- based on experience, plus other allowances as applicable. Candidates need a Master's Degree in Engineering, Technology or Science and 25 years of experience. Send your CV by email. The last date for the university to receive applications is 26 November 2026.

content_sections.heading: About MZU
content_sections.text: Mizoram University is based in Aizawl, Mizoram. DRDO has signed an MoU with Mizoram University to set up the DRDO - Industry Academia Centre of Excellence, Mizoram University (DIA-CoE, MZU) for directed research. The centre works with academic researchers and faculty, start-ups, industries and other institutes in the country to support and advance technology research. It carries out multidisciplinary directed applied research in four areas: Agro Bio Resources for Soldier Survival, Harnessing Environment for Soldier Survival, Defence Waste Management and Human Cognition Studies.

content_sections.heading: Who Can Apply
content_sections.text: Master's Degree in Engineering, Technology or Science from a recognized University 25 years of experience in technology domains/ defence (technical domain), but not limited to the above-mentioned technology areas PhD degree in Engineering, Technology or Science from a recognized University Wide-ranging experience and exposure to collaborative projects, setting up of large research facilities, strategic research planning and technology transfer Exposure to multi-mode projects across Labs/ Organizations/ Academia/ Industry interactions, with awareness of global developments in relevant areas for overall exposure Experience in the defence domain in research/ coordination and technology development/ deployment towards useful outcomes. Alternatively, a strong record of publications and patents, laboratory/ course development and/or other recognized relevant professional activities leading to defence or related technology development in the country. Exposure to Academic and Industry oriented research/ coordination towards realization of technology/ systems Applicants must be below 62 years of age as on the closing date of receipt of applications, which is 26 November 2026. content_sections.heading: Pay and Terms
content_sections.text: Accommodation: Mizoram University may provide accommodation if MZU Quarters are available on the Mizoram University Campus. Medical: The Health Centre at Mizoram University will provide medical facilities. Nature of appointment: This is a full-time contract position. The initial appointment is for 3 years. Extension: The competent authority can extend the period by 2 more years, subject to a performance review. Early exit: Either side may end the position before 3 years by giving 3 months' notice, without giving a reason. Joining: The selected candidate must submit a declaration to join the post within 30 days of the appointment letter being issued.

content_sections.heading: MZU Recruitment 2026 Job Description
content_sections.text: The Director, DIA-CoE, MZU is the administrative and executive head of the centre. The Director will: provide strategic guidance and overall management of the centre develop long-term research and technology roadmaps and implementation strategies aligned with the future technology requirements of DRDO ensure efficient project execution secure industrial collaborations for technology translation facilitate agreements and technical contracts with stakeholders such as DRDO, industries and academia drive knowledge dissemination through workshops, seminars and brainstorming sessions

faq.question: Q1. How many vacancies are there in MZU Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: There is 1 vacancy, for the post of Director, DIA-CoE, Mizoram University. The notice does not print a number, so the single advertised post is counted as 1.

faq.question: Q2. What is the last date to apply for the MZU Director, DIA-CoE post?
faq.answer: The last date for the university to receive the application/CV is 26 November 2026.

faq.question: Q3. What qualification do I need for the Director, DIA-CoE post?
faq.answer: You need a Master's Degree in Engineering, Technology or Science from a recognized University and 25 years of experience in technology domains/ defence (technical domain). A PhD degree in Engineering, Technology or Science is desirable.

faq.question: Q4. What is the age limit for the MZU Director, DIA-CoE post?
faq.answer: You must be below 62 years of age as on the closing date of receipt of applications, which is 26 November 2026.

faq.question: Q5. What is the salary of the Director, DIA-CoE, Mizoram University?
faq.answer: Non-government candidates get Rs. 1,72,200 – 1,99,600/- based on experience, plus other allowances as applicable. Retired Central/State Govt. employees are paid their last drawn salary minus basic pension (OPS) or their last basic pay minus 30% (NPS).

faq.question: Q6. Are allowances paid on top of the pay?
faq.answer: Yes. Non-government candidates get other allowances as applicable on top of Rs. 1,72,200 – 1,99,600/-. Mizoram University may also provide accommodation if MZU Quarters are available, and the university Health Centre will provide medical facilities.

faq.question: Q7. How do I apply for MZU Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Email one PDF file with your detailed CV and a brief statement of why you suit the post to [email protected], with a copy to [email protected]. Name the file <First Name>.<Last Name>.pdf.

faq.question: Q8. What subject line should the application email have?
faq.answer: Use the subject line "Application for Director, DIA-CoE, Mizoram University".

faq.question: Q9. Is the MZU Director, DIA-CoE post permanent?
faq.answer: No. It is a full-time contract position with an initial appointment of 3 years. The competent authority can extend it by 2 years, subject to a performance review.

faq.question: Q10. Do government employees need a no-objection certificate?
faq.answer: Yes. The notice advises people working in full-time positions with government organisations to submit a no-objection certificate from the parent organisation.
